data.name: Features.Command.new-notebook.Detail
data.value: Choose a notebook name, category and one of seven paper templates.

data.name: Features.Command.open-notebooks.Detail
data.value: Save your work and open the library. Click a cover or choose a notebook from the sidebar.

data.name: Features.Command.continue-notebook.Detail
data.value: Return to the saved page, reading position and zoom on this device.

data.name: Features.Command.quick-note.Detail
data.value: Create a ruled page in Quick Notes, in the Inbox category, ready to write with Pen.

data.name: Features.Command.rename-notebook.Detail
data.value: Change the open notebook's title and its single category.

data.name: Features.Command.pin-notebook.Detail
data.value: Keep this notebook above other notebooks. On the home screen use its Notebook actions button.

data.name: Features.Command.cover-color.Detail
data.value: Choose a cover color and pinning in Notebook appearance. Also available from each card's Notebook actions.

data.name: Features.Command.delete-notebook.Detail
data.value: Confirm deletion of the open notebook. A complete recovery copy is kept for up to 30 days.

data.name: Features.Command.sort-library.Detail
data.value: Filter by category or sort by name; pinned notebooks remain first.

data.name: Features.Command.find-notebook.Detail
data.value: Filter notebook titles and categories, not page contents. Ctrl+F focuses this filter on the home screen. Clear search also clears the category filter.

data.name: Features.Command.clear-library-search.Detail
data.value: Clear notebook title and category filtering.

data.name: Features.Command.add-page.Detail
data.value: Choose Blank, Ruled, Grid, Dot Grid, Cornell, Graph or Meeting paper. Insert an A4 page after the current page.

data.name: Features.Command.page-actions.Detail
data.value: Rename, bookmark, duplicate, reorder, move or delete the selected page. The same actions are available beside the thumbnails.

data.name: Features.Command.rename-page.Detail
data.value: Set an optional page title and bookmark without changing its contents.

data.name: Features.Command.bookmark-page.Detail
data.value: Mark this page for later review. Search → Bookmarks lists marked pages across the library.

data.name: Features.Command.duplicate-page.Detail
data.value: Copy this page and its editable contents immediately after the original.

data.name: Features.Command.move-page-up.Detail
data.value: Move the page earlier within this section.

data.name: Features.Command.move-page-down.Detail
data.value: Move the page later within this section.

data.name: Features.Command.move-page-section.Detail
data.value: Choose another existing section; the editor follows the moved page.

data.name: Features.Command.delete-page.Detail
data.value: Delete this page. Undo is available while the notebook stays open; Recently deleted keeps a notebook copy.

data.name: Features.Command.paper-style.Detail
data.value: Change this ordinary page's paper template while retaining notes. PDF pages retain their original background.

data.name: Features.Command.extend-page.Detail
data.value: Add blank space on any edge or corner, including around PDFs, without shrinking existing content. Drag the preview or enter margins in mm.

data.name: Features.Command.add-section.Detail
data.value: Name a topic and create its first paper page.

data.name: Features.Command.section-actions.Detail
data.value: Rename, reorder or delete the current section. At least one section must remain.

data.name: Features.Command.move-section-up.Detail
data.value: Move this topic earlier in the notebook.

data.name: Features.Command.move-section-down.Detail
data.value: Move this topic later in the notebook.

data.name: Features.Command.delete-section.Detail
data.value: Confirm deletion of this section and its pages. Undo and a recovery copy remain available.

data.name: Features.Command.manage-pages.Detail
data.value: Select page checkboxes or use Ctrl/Shift-click. Drag, reorder, duplicate, delete or move pages; Apply changes commits the batch.

data.name: Features.Command.transfer-pages.Detail
data.value: In Manage pages, select pages then Move / copy to notebook. Choose the notebook and section; Keep a copy selects copying instead of moving.

data.name: Features.Command.undo-transfer.Detail
data.value: Reverse the latest transfer in this session only if both notebooks remain unchanged since it completed.

data.name: Features.Command.import-document.Detail
data.value: Preview PDF, DOCX, PPTX, PPSX, ODT or ODP pages; choose ranges and a destination section or notebook. Office formats need a local converter.

data.name: Features.Command.import-folder.Detail
data.value: From My notebooks, import one folder's first-level PDF/PPTX files into a new notebook with one section per file. This is not folder synchronization.

data.name: Features.Command.insert-image.Detail
data.value: Insert PNG or JPEG on the current page. Select exposes move and resize handles; original image bytes stay intact.

data.name: Features.Command.export-pdf.Detail
data.value: Choose current page, section, whole notebook or page ranges, then original-size pages or actual-size A4 sheets. Export does not replace an editable backup.

data.name: Features.Command.a4-export.Detail
data.value: Choose export pages, then A4 sheets · actual size. Set automatic/portrait/landscape orientation and 0–30 mm overlap; preview the sheet grid before saving.

data.name: Features.Command.export-overflow.Detail
data.value: Export checks selected pages for text overflow. Go to selected text returns to editing; Export visible text deliberately exports only the visible portion. Print the saved PDF in a PDF viewer.

data.name: Features.Command.export-completion.Detail
data.value: After successful PDF export, choose Open PDF, Show in folder or Done. Original PDF text remains intact; added text exports as vector outlines, not searchable text.

data.name: Features.Command.search-content.Detail
data.value: Search notebook/category/section/page names, typed text and extractable original PDF text across the library. Ctrl+F also works in the editor outside text inputs. No handwriting recognition or scan OCR.

data.name: Features.Command.search-appearance.Detail
data.value: Find ink or typed text in this notebook by color family, nine page positions, section and mark type. Does not inspect pixels inside images or PDFs.

data.name: Features.Command.bookmarks.Detail
data.value: Open the library-wide bookmarked-page list. The Bookmarked pages only filter can also narrow a content search.

data.name: Features.Command.go-to-page.Detail
data.value: Enter a page number within the current section, or click the page counter.

data.name: Features.Command.back-to-page.Detail
data.value: Return to a remembered search, question, practice or quick-note visit. This is session history, not every scroll or thumbnail click.

data.name: Features.Command.mark-question.Detail
data.value: Use the selected content or choose a source region. Write the question, explanation and next attempt; manually set Need help, Understood, Try again or Resolved.

data.name: Features.Command.question-inbox.Detail
data.value: Search, edit or remove questions across this notebook. Include resolved questions shows completed items; Open source returns to and briefly outlines the source region.

data.name: Features.Command.resume-hint.Detail
data.value: Save one next-step note on this page or selected region. Edit or clear an existing hint; saved hints appear in the Continue strip.

data.name: Features.Command.resume-thinking.Detail
data.value: Search, edit or remove this notebook's saved next steps and open their source pages. These notes are not included in ordinary content search.

data.name: Features.Command.new-practice.Detail
data.value: Capture any page region as a saved question image and create a ruled solution page. No marked Question is required. From a practice page, reuse the saved snapshot for another attempt.

data.name: Features.Command.practice-attempts.Detail
data.value: Review earlier solutions, record mistakes and a next approach, mark Reviewed, open the Original page or create Another attempt. Save & open saves reflections; Close cancels them.

data.name: Features.Command.restore-region.Detail
data.value: Choose an earlier compatible page version and a region. Restore complete ink strokes, text and images inside it; other work stays. History lasts only while this notebook stays open.

data.name: Features.Command.single-page.Detail
data.value: Show one editable page per row without changing page contents or export order.

data.name: Features.Command.two-pages.Detail
data.value: Edit adjacent pairs 1–2, 3–4 within this section. Both pages remain editable; an odd last page stays on its own.

data.name: Features.Command.fit-width.Detail
data.value: Fit page/spread width and keep fitting when the window or sidebar changes.

data.name: Features.Command.actual-size.Detail
data.value: Return to 100% scale. This changes the view, not stored page coordinates.

data.name: Features.Command.zoom-in.Detail
data.value: Increase scale up to 400%. Ctrl+mouse wheel and pinch zoom are also available.

data.name: Features.Command.zoom-out.Detail
data.value: Reduce scale down to 25% without shrinking saved notes.

data.name: Features.Command.sidebar.Detail
data.value: Show Contents and Notebooks beside the writing area.

data.name: Features.Command.focus-mode.Detail
data.value: Use full-screen writing with floating tools and All tools. F11 toggles full screen while keeping Paper only if enabled. Restore workspace returns to the normal workspace.

data.name: Features.Command.reference-view.Detail
data.value: Open a read-only snapshot of another notebook/page beside writing. Choose pages, zoom or Fit independently; Refresh reloads it, Back to writing returns focus, and Close hides the pane.

data.name: Features.Command.workspace-settings.Detail
data.value: Set two-finger navigation, zoom lock, compact favorite toolbar and focus-tool docking. Changes stay on this device.

data.name: Features.Command.two-finger-navigation.Name
data.value: Require two fingers to move pages

data.name: Features.Command.two-finger-navigation.Detail
data.value: Ignore one-finger page drags. Fingers navigate rather than draw ink.

data.name: Features.Command.zoom-lock.Detail
data.value: Lock zoom, including Fit Page, Fit Width and Actual Size, until you turn this setting off.

data.name: Features.Command.compact-toolbar.Detail
data.value: Hide only the normal favorite-pen row. Favorites remain available by number and in Manage pens.

data.name: Features.Command.focus-docking.Detail
data.value: Choose the side used by the floating focus toolbar; writing and reference content keep clear of it.

data.name: Features.Command.pen.Detail
data.value: Write with pressure-sensitive ink using an active pen, or draw with the mouse.

data.name: Features.Command.highlighter.Detail
data.value: Highlight with native 50% transparency. Pen and Highlighter retain their working colors separately.

data.name: Features.Command.eraser.Detail
data.value: Recall the last pixel/stroke eraser mode. Use Eraser settings to choose mode, size and highlighter-only erasing.

data.name: Features.Command.lasso.Detail
data.value: Circle ink, text and images together. Drag to move, use edge handles to resize, or press Esc during a move to cancel.

data.name: Features.Command.type.Detail
data.value: Begin or resume free typing. Click empty paper for another text item; ruled paper aligns its lines. Ctrl+Enter finishes typing.

data.name: Features.Command.select.Detail
data.value: Select a text item or image, then drag its move/resize handles. Free typing hides these handles until Select is active.

data.name: Features.Command.pen-settings.Detail
data.value: Choose ink color and thickness, save a preset or enable Draw and Hold. A selected ink stroke can be recolored or resized here.

data.name: Features.Command.ink-color.Detail
data.value: Choose a swatch or More Colors. The color picker includes hue and saturation/brightness, Current/New previews, Apply and Cancel.

data.name: Features.Command.more-colors.Detail
data.value: Open the full color picker for the current pen or selected ink/text. No hex-input or eyedropper is provided.

data.name: Features.Command.ink-width.Detail
data.value: Choose one of 21 thickness levels with a live sample. Selected ink updates as one undoable change after the slider drag.

data.name: Features.Command.draw-hold.Detail
data.value: Hold a roughly straight line's endpoint for about 0.65 seconds to straighten it, then keep dragging to adjust. Works with Pen and Highlighter; not a general shape recognizer.

data.name: Features.Command.save-pen-preset.Detail
data.value: Name a new Pen/Highlighter preset using the current working settings. At most 40 presets can be saved.

data.name: Features.Command.manage-pens.Detail
data.value: Rename, duplicate, delete or reorder presets; choose tool, color and width; set opacity, pressure, smoothing and favorites. Save and Use applies the selected preset, including hidden ones.

data.name: Features.Command.pen-opacity.Detail
data.value: Set 10–100% opacity for Pen presets. Highlighter uses fixed native 50% transparency.

data.name: Features.Command.pressure.Detail
data.value: Enable or disable pressure for a saved pen preset. Actual pressure requires compatible pen hardware.

data.name: Features.Command.smoothing.Detail
data.value: Enable or disable smoothing for a saved pen preset.

data.name: Features.Command.favorite-pens.Detail
data.value: Choose Show in favourite toolbar, reorder with arrows, or drag visible favorites. The first nine favorites get number shortcuts; Focus shows the first three.

data.name: Features.Command.eraser-settings.Detail
data.value: Choose Pixel or Stroke Eraser, change its independent size, or protect pen strokes with Erase highlighter only.

data.name: Features.Command.pixel-eraser.Detail
data.value: Erase only the touched portion of ink; remaining fragments stay editable. It does not erase text, images or backgrounds.

data.name: Features.Command.stroke-eraser.Detail
data.value: Touch part of an ink stroke to remove the entire stroke.

data.name: Features.Command.eraser-size.Detail
data.value: Adjust the eraser footprint from 12 to 120 page DIP, independently of pen width.

data.name: Features.Command.text-formatting.Detail
data.value: Show fonts, size, bold, italic, color, alignment, lists and text continuation. Formatting applies to the whole text item, not selected words. Browsing these tools does not create text.

data.name: Features.Command.text-font.Detail
data.value: Choose Segoe UI, Arial, Calibri, Microsoft JhengHei, Consolas or Times New Roman for the whole text item.

data.name: Features.Command.text-size.Detail
data.value: Choose or enter a size from 6 to 96 pt for the whole text item.

data.name: Features.Command.text-bold.Detail
data.value: Toggle bold for the entire selected text item. Use Ctrl+B while typing.

data.name: Features.Command.text-italic.Detail
data.value: Toggle italic for the entire selected text item. Use Ctrl+I while typing.

data.name: Features.Command.text-color.Detail
data.value: Choose the selected text item's color. This is a color control, not underline formatting.

data.name: Features.Command.text-alignment.Detail
data.value: Align the selected text item Left, Center or Right.

data.name: Features.Command.finish-typing.Detail
data.value: Commit text editing and return to Pen. Native text undo and IME keep their own keys while typing.

data.name: Features.Command.selection-actions.Detail
data.value: Copy, cut, paste, select all, duplicate, delete or nudge editable page content. Native text controls keep their text clipboard behavior.

data.name: Features.Command.select-all.Detail
data.value: Select all ink, text and images on this page with Lasso; PDF backgrounds are not selectable objects.

data.name: Features.Command.paste.Detail
data.value: Paste a Penroam selection, legacy ink, plain text or screenshot/image outside native text editing.

data.name: Features.Command.duplicate-selection.Detail
data.value: Create another editable copy of the selected ink, text or image.

data.name: Features.Command.delete-selection.Detail
data.value: Remove the selected ink, text or images. Notebook Undo restores the completed change.

data.name: Features.Command.undo.Detail
data.value: Undo a completed notebook edit while this notebook remains open. While typing, Ctrl+Z belongs to the native text editor.

data.name: Features.Command.redo.Detail
data.value: Redo an undone notebook edit. A new edit clears redo history.

data.name: Features.Command.save-now.Detail
data.value: Commit pending editor input and save this notebook locally. Completed edits also save automatically.

data.name: Features.Command.retry-save.Detail
data.value: Retry failed notebook and writing-preference saves. Pending content stays in memory on failure.

data.name: Features.Command.backup-notebook.Detail
data.value: Save every section and its editable content, including pending edits, as a .moye backup.

data.name: Features.Command.backup-all.Detail
data.value: Create an editable .moye backup of the library. Backups are not encrypted and do not include device-local writing/workspace preferences.

data.name: Features.Command.restore-backup.Detail
data.value: Validate a backup, select notebooks and restore them as new copies without overwriting existing notebooks.

data.name: Features.Command.backup-recovery.Detail
data.value: Check automatic backup status, restore backups, recover interrupted drafts or restore Recently deleted notebook copies.

data.name: Features.Command.recover-drafts.Detail
data.value: In Interrupted drafts, recover a selected snapshot as a new copy or discard it. Drafts depend on local library assets and are best effort, not portable backups.

data.name: Features.Command.recently-deleted.Detail
data.value: Restore a complete notebook copy kept before page/section/notebook deletion, for up to 30 days; move wanted pages back yourself. Delete permanently requires confirmation.

data.name: Features.Command.automatic-backups.Detail
data.value: Enable backups while Penroam is open, choose a folder, set a 1–168 hour interval and keep 1–100 completed backups. This is not a Windows background task.

data.name: Features.Command.backup-folder.Detail
data.value: Choose where automatic backups are stored; another storage device gives better protection against disk failure.

data.name: Features.Command.backup-interval.Detail
data.value: Choose an interval from 1 to 168 hours. Backups defer during busy work or pen input.

data.name: Features.Command.backup-retention.Detail
data.value: Keep 1–100 completed automatic backups. Manual backup files are not deleted by this retention policy.

data.name: Features.Command.check-updates.Detail
data.value: Check GitHub stable releases. Update now downloads and verifies the installer, then saves before installing; Later and Cancel download keep you working.

data.name: Features.Command.writing-settings-warning.Detail
data.value: Inspect a protected/unreadable preference-file warning or retry a pending settings save. A newer settings file is not overwritten.

data.name: Features.Command.keyboard-help.Detail
data.value: B/H/E/L/T/V choose tools; 1–9 choose favorites. Ctrl+Shift+F searches content; Ctrl+G goes to a page; F9 toggles the sidebar and F11 Focus. Outside text/selection editing, arrows and PageUp/PageDown navigate pages and Home/End reach section ends. Shift+F10 opens a focused page/section menu. Ctrl+Shift+P opens All tools.

data.name: Features.Command.pan-touch-help.Detail
data.value: Hold Space and drag with the left mouse button to pan temporarily. One finger scrolls with inertia; two fingers pan and pinch zoom. Fingers navigate, not draw. Pen contact pauses navigation; a compatible pen tail eraser follows the selected eraser mode. Hardware pressure and palm rejection depend on the device and drivers.

data.name: Features.Command.typing-help.Detail
data.value: Type creates/resumes editable text; click empty paper for more. Free text aligns to horizontal guides on Ruled/Cornell/Meeting, but added blank margins are free placement. Use fixed Text box for unsnapped layouts. Windows IME works natively. Formatting applies to the whole text item; selected words cannot have independent styles.

data.name: Features.Command.autosave-help.Detail
data.value: Completed edits queue local saves; the footer reports success or failure. Opening a notebook restores its saved page, zoom and reading position on this device. Preferences are separate from notebook backups. Failed saves keep pending content; interrupted-draft recovery cannot guarantee the final stroke or active composition.

data.name: Features.Command.document-help.Detail
data.value: PDF import needs no Office app. DOCX requires Word or LibreOffice; PPTX/PPSX require PowerPoint or LibreOffice; ODT/ODP require LibreOffice. Converted pages are static PDF backgrounds, not editable Office objects. Passwords, macros, linked external resources and unsupported PDF forms/signatures are rejected. Sources stay unchanged; folder import only accepts first-level PDF/PPTX.

data.name: Features.Command.isolated-library-help.Detail
data.value: The advanced --data-dir launch argument selects an independent library and preference directory, and disables update checks. There is no in-app library-file switcher. Never move an active SQLite database without its journal files.

data.name: Features.Command.erase-highlighter-only.Detail
data.value: Protect ordinary pen strokes while erasing highlights; available with both eraser modes.

data.value: Create a fixed-layout text box rather than free typing. Use separate boxes for different formatting.

data.name: Features.Command.bullet-list.Detail
data.value: Toggle plain-text bullet prefixes on current or selected lines. Enter continues a list; an empty marked line ends it.

data.name: Features.Command.numbered-list.Detail
data.value: Toggle plain-text numbering on current or selected lines. Markers remain editable characters.

data.value: Keep visible text on this page and move overflow, with formatting, to a new page. This is explicit pagination, not linked automatic text flow.

data.value: Copy editable mixed ink, text and images to another page or notebook, preserving image assets and ink attributes.

data.value: Copy the editable selection and remove it from this page after copying succeeds.

data.value: Choose Type to write, or Select to format existing text. Formatting applies to the whole text item.

data.name: Features.Command.paper-only.Detail
data.value: Hide menus and toolbars without changing the window size. Click the floating circle to open writing tools. F10 toggles Paper only; Esc first closes an open tool panel, then restores the workspace.
